title.en: Top Zambian opposition figures arrested days after presidential vote
title.zh: 赞比亚反对派高层人物在总统选举几天后被捕

summary.en: The authorities allege they were involved in an insurrection plot but the leading opposition candidate says there was an attempt on his life.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及公义、尊严与问责。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Security forces in Zambia have seized weapons and arrested 11 people, including senior opposition figures, allegedly involved in an insurrection plot, the government has said.

The leading opposition candidate in last Thursday's presidential election, Brian Mundubile, was also found at the scene of the raid in the capital, Lusaka, according to the country's top civil servant Patrick Kangwa.

Mundubile described Friday night's raid as "an attempt on my life" adding that "colleagues were shot" in his presence.

With results from more than half of the constituencies, he is trailing incumbent Hakainde Hichilema. Mundubile had earlier claimed victory and alleged there were voting irregularities.

But he has not provided detailed evidence of these or of who was shot on Friday. In fact, tangible evidence to back up accusations made by the opposition, government and the electoral commission in the wake of Thursday vote has been lacking.

The authorities denied the claims of vote rigging and in preliminary statements observers described election day as largely peaceful and orderly.

They did however raise concerns about late electoral reforms, media freedom and access to the media in the run-up to the poll.

Giving more details about the raid, Kangwa said the individuals arrested were connected to "military plans involving foreign nationals and illegal military training camps". He added that they posed "a serious threat to state security" and held "high-grade military weapons", ammunition and other materials intended for use in an armed insurrection.

He alleged that shots were fired at law enforcement officers leading to an exchange of fire.

Among those arrested were Patrick Mwansa, the husband of Tasila Lungu, the daughter of former Zambian President Edgar Lungu, and other politicians.

The mood remains stable as Zambians await the full results of the election, although some uncertainty has emerged following the government's announcement of the raid.

However, there is a heightened security police presence in some parts of the capital.

Mundubile had made a series of allegations about the electoral process, including reports of military involvement at tallying centres and irregularities involving ballot boxes.

He later said he was being interrogated by Zambian army officers over two videos he released and alleged he had been assaulted while in custody, which authorities denied.

He also accused Tanzania of sending individuals to interfere in the election, an allegation the Tanzanian government firmly rejected as false and unfounded.

Zambia's electoral commission briefly suspended the counting and announcement of results on Friday, citing violence against polling staff and theft of marked ballot papers.

title.en: Ukrainian strikes kill six in Russia, acting governor says
title.zh: 代理州长称，乌克兰袭击在俄罗斯造成六人死亡

summary.en: Ukrainian strikes reportedly killed six people, including a 14-year-old child, and injured four others in Russia's Belgorod region, according to the acting governor.
summary.zh: 据代理州长称，乌克兰对俄罗斯别尔哥罗德地区的袭击据报造成六人死亡，其中包括一名14岁儿童，另有四人受伤。

body.en:
Six people have been killed and four injured in Ukrainian missile strikes on Russia's Belgorod region overnight, its acting governor has said.

A 14-year-old child was among those injured, Alexander Shuvaev wrote on Telegram on Monday.

Ukraine officials said two people were killed in Russian drone strikes overnight on the Sumy region, close to the border with Russia, which has been under frequent attack.

The strikes come a night after what Russian officials called the "largest-scale" attack launched by Ukraine this year, in which at least seven people were killed. Russian attacks on Ukraine also killed at least seven people and injured more than 39 on Saturday night.

Russia launched its full-scale invasion of Ukraine in February 2022 and currently controls approximately a fifth of Ukrainian territory.

The latest Ukrainian strikes burned a building and damaged a car in the village of Koloskovo in the Valuysky district, which is close to Russia's border with Ukraine, Shuvaev said.

The injured child was sent to hospital while two others received medical assistance, he added.

Meanwhile, a woman was killed after a drone strike hit a home in Russia's southern Astrakhan region, the local governor said on Monday.

Igor Babushkin wrote on Telegram that the Ukrainian strike targeted an industrial facility but that it had not been damaged.

In Ukraine, an overnight attack on the Black Sea port city of Odesa damaged a civilian vessel and injured four people, according to the regional head Oleh Kiper.

Moscow has sought to put off foreign companies from trading with Ukraine by targeting its ports and coastline.

On Saturday night, Ukraine fired some 822 drones towards Russia, with 600 aiming for Moscow, according to its regional governor, who said the Russian capital suffered "one of the most massive drone attacks in recent memory".

During the strikes on Saturday night, five people died in Russia's south-western region of Rostov, its governor said. A woman was killed in an attack on a civilian bus in Belgorod, officials said, while an 83-year-old man died in a drone attack in the Moscow region.

The Ukrainian energy company Naftogaz said on Monday that Russia had attacked its facilities 13 times during the past week.

In Russian attacks on Ukraine on Saturday night, a man and woman died after a private house was hit by a guided aerial bomb in the Zaporizhzhia region, officials said. Five others were killed in attacks across the country.

reflection.en: The tragic loss of life, including a child, in these strikes highlights the devastating human cost when cycles of violence continue. It reminds us of the profound challenge to resist the urge to respond to evil with more evil. Yahweh calls us instead to overcome evil with good, seeking pathways that break these destructive patterns.
reflection.zh: 这些袭击中包括一名儿童在内的生命悲剧性逝去，凸显了暴力循环持续时所付出的惨重代价。它提醒我们，抵制以恶报恶的冲动是一个深刻的挑战。雅伟呼召我们以善胜恶，寻求打破这些破坏性模式的途径。

verse.textEn: Do not be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.
verse.textZh: 你不可为恶所胜，反要以善胜恶。

title.en: Trump envoy Kushner arrives in Israel after rare Hamas talks on Gaza peace plan
title.zh: 特朗普特使库什纳在与哈马斯就加沙和平计划进行罕见会谈后抵达以色列

summary.en: Jared Kushner, son-in-law of US President Trump, has arrived in Israel for talks on a Gaza peace plan and is scheduled to meet with Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu.
summary.zh: 美国总统特朗普的女婿贾里德·库什纳已抵达以色列，就加沙和平计划进行会谈，并计划于周一晚些时候会见以色列总理本雅明·内塔尼亚胡。

body.en:
US President Donald Trump's Middle East envoy Jared Kushner has arrived in Israel, where he is expected to meet Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu on Monday.

It comes after Kushner held rare talks with Hamas to discuss the implementation of the US-backed Gaza peace plan.

Last month, Trump's Board of Peace said it had reached agreement for the "complete disarmament" of Hamas and other armed groups in Gaza. Last week, Israel rejected Trump's 15-point plan, which also calls for Israeli troops to withdraw and for Gaza to be rebuilt under a new civilian Palestinian administration.

Eight Muslim countries issued a statement on Sunday condemning Israel's rejection.

Trump leads the Board of Peace, which was created as an international organisation originally intended to bring peace to Gaza, but later expanded to include conflicts worldwide.

A Palestinian official told the BBC Trump's son-in-law met a delegation led by Hamas's new leader Khalil al-Hayya in Egypt on Sunday.

In a statement, Hamas later called on mediators and the Board of Peace to "compel" Israel to approve the roadmap for the next steps.

But Netanyahu faces a tough October election to try to hold onto power, with a coalition that includes ministers in favour of taking a harsher line on Gaza.

Kushner's meeting with Hayya is believed to be the first at this level since last year's agreement of a ceasefire for the Gaza Strip.

High representative for Gaza to the US-led Board of Peace, Nickolay Mladenov, and former UK Prime Minister Tony Blair were reportedly also part of the meeting, alongside representatives of Egypt, Qatar and Turkey, which have mediated in the peace efforts.

No official statement has been released of the talks, reportedly focusing on concrete actions to decommission Hamas's weapons, as well as the withdrawal of Israeli troops and humanitarian efforts.

A source with knowledge of the meeting told CBS News, the BBC's US partner, that the meeting's contents included "beginning to transfer all governing responsibilities to the National Committee for the Administration of Gaza, ensuring Hamas has no future governing role in Gaza, facilitating Israeli withdrawals and deploying an international stabilising force to the region".

While in Egypt, Kushner also met Egyptian President Abdel Fattah al-Sisi. According to Israeli media reports, Mladenov and Blair will also meet Netanyahu on Monday with the aim of advancing Trump's plan.

The Israeli prime minister has said he wants a full Hamas disarmament first in order to implement the deal.

"Israel rejects the Board of Peace's 15-point document on Gaza. The IDF (Israel Defense Forces) will not carry out any withdrawal until Hamas is genuinely disarmed," Netanyahu said last week, defying Israel's closest ally.

title.en: Aid shortages and fears of starvation as Indonesia reels from deadly earthquake
title.zh: 印度尼西亚遭受致命地震，援助短缺和饥饿担忧

summary.en: Some 53 people were killed and thousands displaced by the earthquake, which struck early on Saturday.

body.en:
Aid disruptions and aftershocks across the Indonesian island of Flores are fuelling fears among thousands of survivors who were displaced by a 7.7 magnitude earthquake on Saturday.

Refugees are sleeping outdoors through sweltering days and frigid nights for fear that more buildings may collapse. Tents set up amid the rubble of collapsed hospitals are serving as makeshift emergency rooms for injured patients. And as landslides sever access roads and supplies dwindle in several parts of the island, there are growing concerns about how much longer survivors can hold out.

At least 53 people were killed and some 5,000 displaced by the initial quake, which struck shortly before 06:00 Saturday (23:00 GMT Friday) at a depth of just 15km.

It is the country's deadliest earthquake since 2022, when hundreds of people were killed in West Java.

"We heard that medical assistance would be provided, but nothing has arrived yet," Rista Mari, a public relations officer at the Ruteng Regional General Hospital in Manggarai Regency, told the BBC. "We hope that assistance will arrive soon."

Early data from Indonesia's National Disaster Management Agency indicates that more than 1,000 houses have been damaged, along with dozens of health facilities, schools and government offices.

In Flores' westernmost town of Labuan Bajo, the gateway to Komodo National Park and one of Indonesia's most popular tourist destinations, many survivors have been sleeping outdoors, fearful that if the tremors continue they might be crushed in their sleep.

"The shaking was very scary. My house almost collapsed," said one farmer named Anastasia Imad, from a green emergency tent erected next to her damaged home. "We were worried that the aftershocks would collapse the house while we were sleeping."

Herry Kabut, editor-in-chief of local publication Floresa Media, told the BBC that "each resident has set up their own evacuation post" amid blackouts, landslides and roadblocks.

"So far, many basic necessities such as [basic foodstuffs] and clean water are in great demand," he said. "People have no idea where to evacuate. There's been no government advice. Many have fled to the hills and are starving."

Health services across the island have similarly been forced to move outside and set up emergency tents due to damaged facilities. Ruteng Regional General Hospital's operating room, delivery room, pharmacy, and laboratory were all rendered defunct after the building's roof collapsed.

Elsewhere, in Ngada Regency, local resident Charles Abar told the BBC that health facilities and equipment had been severely damaged and that, as of Sunday night, no medical assistance had arrived.

title.en: Movie that went viral for terrible animation becomes China box office hit
title.zh: 因糟糕的动画而走红的电影成为中国票房热门

summary.en: Niu Lai's confusing plot and laughable animation quality has won ironic fans on the internet.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Niu Lai, a low-budget animation film about a cow in a dream sequence has seen a huge jump in ticket sales after going viral for its confusing plot and terrible graphics.

It grossed just 7,705 yuan ($1,140; £843) in the first 10 days after its release, but has now made more than 11.4 million yuan, according to movie tracking site Mao Yan. That means it is holding ground against Hollywood blockbusters like The Odyssey and Spider Man: Brand New Day.

"You may regret for 80 minutes if you watch it, but if you don't, you'll regret it for life," one popular social media post about the film said.

Other social media users have hailed the movie as the antidote to the AI slop that is taking over social media algorithms.

They are sharing clips praising Niu Lai's "hand-crafted" method - a reference to the poor animation quality - as "proof" that its creators did not use AI.

Another social media user called it "pure handmade" and the biggest "dark horse" of the summer movie season.

Others say they are rooting for the movie because they desperately hope for a "bullish" stock market.

"If the index reaches 4,000 tomorrow I will go to the cinema to support this movie," one Weibo user wrote.

"It is a terrible movie but has a great name," another comment linking the movie to stock investments said.

Niu Lai was a low-budget, lowkey production from the outset, and had received almost no publicity before its release earlier this month.

But now it has proved so popular that cinemas have added screenings of the film in response to the soaring demand.

But given that it does not even have a proper promotional poster, cinema staff have resorted to drawing their own posters to entice audiences to watch.

"This record is unprecedented and will likely remain so," a Weibo account dedicated to tracking movies noted.

But not everyone is celebrating its unexpected success. Over the weekend, a commentary by state-owned Beijing News warned that cinemas risk "losing the trust" of viewers if they "continue to lower their standard" with additional screenings of Niu Lai.

Mentioning previous movies that had been mocked for poor quality, Niu Lai has "once again lowered the bar for audiences' expectations of poorly made films", reads a commentary by state-owned Beijing News.

It urged cinemas to "act as gatekeepers for the audience, and clearly reject films that are obviously not up to standard instead of letting films like Niu Lai run rampant".
body.zh: 《牛来》是一部讲述一头牛在梦境中的低成本动画电影，因其令人困惑的情节和糟糕的画面而走红后，票房收入大幅增长。 据电影追踪网站猫眼称，该片上映后 10 天的票房收入仅为 7,705 元人民币（1,140 美元；843 英镑），但目前已超过 1140 万元人民币。这意味着它在与《奥德赛》和《蜘蛛侠：全新一天》等好莱坞大片的竞争中占据一席之地。 “如果你看它，你可能会后悔80分钟，但如果你不看，你会后悔一生，”一篇关于这部电影的热门社交媒体帖子说道。 其他社交媒体用户称赞这部电影是应对正在接管社交媒体算法的人工智能问题的解毒剂。 他们分享的视频赞扬了牛来的“手工制作”方法——指的是糟糕的动画质量——作为其创作者没有使用人工智能的“证据”。 另一位社交媒体用户称其为“纯手工制作”，是暑期电影季最大的“黑马”。 其他人则表示，他们之所以支持这部电影，是因为他们迫切希望股市“牛市”。 一位微博用户写道：“如果明天指数达到4000，我会去电影院支持这部电影。” 另一位将这部电影与股票投资联系起来的评论说：“这是一部糟糕的电影，但名字却很好。” 《牛来》从一开始就是一部低预算、低调的作品，在本月初上映之前几乎没有受到任何宣传。 但现在事实证明，它非常受欢迎，以至于电影院增加了这部电影的放映次数，以应对不断飙升的需求。 但由于连合适的宣传海报都没有，影院工作人员只好自己画海报来吸引观众观看。 “这个记录是史无前例的，而且很可能会保持下去，”一个专门追踪电影的微博账号指出。 但并非所有人都在庆祝其意外的成功。周末，国有媒体《新京报》的一篇评论警告称，如果电影院“继续降低标准”增加放映《牛来》，就有“失去观众信任”的风险。 国有媒体《新京报》发表评论称，提到之前因质量低劣而被嘲笑的电影，牛来“再次降低了观众对劣质电影的期望”。 它敦促电影院“充当观众的把关人，明确拒绝那些明显不合格的电影，而不是让《牛来》这样的电影泛滥成灾”。

title.en: US actress Hayden Panettiere dies at 36
title.zh: 美国女演员海顿·潘妮蒂尔去世，享年36岁

summary.en: Hayden Panettiere's death was announced by her father in a statement to US network ABC news. The actress was known for her roles in TV shows such as "Nashville" and "Heroes."
summary.zh: 海顿·潘妮蒂尔的父亲在美国广播公司新闻发布声明，宣布了她的死讯。这位女演员因出演《纳什维尔》和《英雄》等电视剧而闻名。

body.en:
Hayden Panettiere's death was announced by her father in a statement to US network ABC news. The actress was known for her roles in TV shows such as "Nashville" and "Heroes."

Hayden Panettiere, best known for her roles in US TV shows "Heroes" and "Nashville," has died aged 36, US media reports said.

"It is with profound sadness that we share the tragic passing of our beloved Hayden. She was an incredible light and a force of nature who brought immeasurable love and joy to all who knew her — and to the millions who watched her onscreen," Panettiere's father, Skip, was quoted by ABC news as saying.

The cause of Panettiere's death has not yet been announced. Her father has urged for privacy.

Panettiere began her career as a child actor, featuring in commercials and soap operas.

She gained ‌widespread recognition as the voice of Dot, the young princess ant in Pixar's 1998 animated success "A ​Bug's Life," and earned a  Grammy nomination for the film's spoken word album for children.

Panettiere catapulted to fame with her role as Claire Bennett — a high school cheerleader ​with super powers —  on NBC's television series "Heroes," which debuted in 2006 and went on to be a hit.

She also starred as up-and-coming country singer Juliette Barnes for six seasons on the musical drama "Nashville."

Panettiere also worked in two films of the satirical horror "Scream" franchise, "Bring It On: All Or Nothing," "I Love You Beth Cooper" and "Remember the Titans."

Her last appearance was in the ​psychological thriller "Sleepwalker," which was released in ⁠the US in January.

Panettiere was open about her struggles with alcohol addiction and depression.

Her younger brother —  actor Jansen Panettiere —  died in 2023 at 28 due to a heart condition.

Hayden's memoir was published earlier this year, where she spoke about her battle with mental health, the loss of her brother, and her decision to give full custody of her daughter to her former partner, Ukrainian boxer Wladimir Klitschko.

title.en: 'An incredible light': Nashville and Heroes star Hayden Panettiere dead at 36
title.zh: “不可思议的光芒”：纳什维尔和英雄明星海顿·潘妮蒂尔去世，享年36岁

summary.en: Hayden Panettiere, known for her roles in "Nashville" and "Heroes," has passed away at the age of 36. The cause of the actor's death has not been disclosed.
summary.zh: 因出演《音乐之乡》和《英雄》而闻名的演员海顿·潘妮蒂尔去世，享年36岁。这位演员的死因尚未公布。

body.en:
Hayden Panettiere, star of popular television series including Heroes and Nashville, has died. She was 36.

Panettiere’s father, Skip, announced the actor’s death in a statement provided to the US network ABC News on Monday.

"It is with profound sadness that we share the tragic passing of our beloved Hayden. She was an incredible light and a force of nature who brought immeasurable love and joy to all who knew her — and to the millions who watched her onscreen," his statement said.

No cause of death was announced, and a publicist for Panettiere did not immediately respond to an email from the Associated Press (AP).

Panettiere, who would have turned 37 this week, began her career as a child actor in commercials and soap operas.

Her role as a cheerleader with superpowers in Heroes propelled her to fame in 2006, with the series revolving around the mantra "Save the cheerleader, save the world."

"I think Heroes is really hot because it’s just a really great combination of everything that people love — they love reality, they love sci-fi and things like X-Men where they get to dream of something bigger," Panettiere told AP in 2008.

"And at the core of it are these human stories that people can relate to, very rugged. And it’s just grabbed everyone in every age group."

She went on to win three Teen Choice Awards for that role and was a Grammy Award nominee for a children’s spoken word album recorded a few years after the release of the animated movie A Bug’s Life.

Panettiere later played a brash country upstart opposite Connie Britton on Nashville, which aired on US network ABC for four seasons before being cancelled and revived on CMT.

She did her own singing in the show, which scored some hits on country charts, spawned US tours and earned Panettiere two supporting actress Golden Globe nominations.

Panettiere had 11 songs recorded for Nashville appear on Billboard’s Hot Country Songs charts during the show’s run, including two featuring Britton.

Panettiere's younger brother, Jansen, who was also an actor, died of a heart condition in 2023, at age 28.

She had been open about her struggles with alcohol addiction and depression, including after the birth of her daughter with Ukrainian boxer Wladimir Klitschko in 2014.

In an interview with podcaster Jay Shetty after her memoir came out in May, Panettiere talked about the custody arrangement for her 11-year-old daughter, who lives full-time with Klitschko in Ukraine.

News of the 2018 decision prompted headlines about Panettiere giving up custody of her daughter.

title.en: US sailors are said to be jumping off this warship — and Iran is capitalising
title.zh: 据称美国水手跳离军舰，伊朗正从中渔利

summary.en: Reports indicate that US sailors have been jumping off a warship that has set a modern-day record for consecutive days at sea. Iran is reportedly capitalizing on these incidents.
summary.zh: 据报道，美国水手从一艘军舰上跳下，这艘军舰已创下现代连续海上部署天数的新纪录。据称，伊朗正在利用这些事件。

body.en:
Donald Trump may have several problems in the war against Iran — but a ship ain't one.

Or so the United States president insists, after batting away concerns of difficult conditions on board a long-deployed warship playing a major part in the conflict.

There are growing concerns for the crew members aboard the USS Abraham Lincoln, which is currently on a record-breaking nine months at sea. The warship was deployed to the Middle East in January and is supporting US military operations by carrying aircraft and assisting the blockade of Iranian ports .

Without a port call in more than 200 days, it has broken modern US Navy records for consecutive days at sea. Dozens of military families have complained of food shortages, plumbing problems and declining mental health among crew members, with some even telling US media of attempts by loved ones to jump overboard.

Though the vessel is now returning to port, Trump has dismissed concerns about lengthy deployments, saying the ship has been at sea "not nearly long enough".

But as the war shows no signs of ending, his administration is facing not just concerns from military families, but domestic calls for investigations and questions over his military strategy.

There are roughly 5,000 sailors and US Marines on board the vessel, according to US politicians.

Two military-focused outlets, Navy Times and Stars and Stripes, reported sailors were jumping overboard due to burnout and low morale. The outlets spoke to the wives of sailors who had either tried to jump or had witnessed and intervened when others tried to.

In a letter to US defence secretary Pete Hegseth, US Democratic senator Richard Blumenthal described reports of supply shortages, water contamination, plumbing issues, deteriorating mental health, deck safety concerns, and disruptions in the mail system.

Blumenthal also raised concern that extended Navy deployments may be becoming normalised as a "feature rather than an exception" in US military strategy.

But the Trump administration has dismissed media reports as misinformation. Hegseth said reports about conditions on the ship "completely misrepresented" the situation and that the government ensured every ship had "everything" that can be provided at "every single moment".

US Central Command (CENTCOM) said no service members aboard the aircraft carrier have died, but acknowledged one sailor who fell overboard on 3 August "was quickly and safely recovered" — without detailing why the incident occurred.

title.en: In pictures: What one of the world's greatest rivers kept hidden — until now
title.zh: 图片：世界最伟大河流之一曾隐藏的秘密——如今显露

summary.en: The Danube River's significantly lowered water levels have exposed extensive sandbanks across Europe, leading to the discovery of previously submerged historical artifacts and treasures.
summary.zh: 多瑙河水位显著下降，欧洲各地大片沙洲显露出来，同时也揭示了此前沉没于水下的历史文物和宝藏。

body.en:
Water levels on the Danube River, the second-longest in Europe, have dropped so low because of drought that the hulks of dozens of World War Two German warships are emerging into view.

They are a curious distraction from the summer heat crisis. The Danube’s record-low water levels have also pushed power plants to the brink of shutting down, and governments across Central and Eastern Europe are taking steps to conserve electricity.

In the middle of the river separating Serbia and Romania near the Serbian port of Prahovo, a rusty hull is now visible along with a broken mast where the Nazi flag used to fly.

The ships, some still laden with weapons, belonged to Nazi Germany’s Black Sea fleet that the Germans deliberately sank as they retreated from Romania and as Soviet forces advanced deeper into Europe near the end of the war.

Historians say up to 200 German warships were scuttled in September 1944 near Prahovo in the Danube gorge as they came under Soviet fire. The idea behind the deliberate sinking was to slow down the Soviet advance in the Balkans. But Nazi Germany surrendered months later, in May 1945.

The sight of the old warships is a reminder that the Serbian government, with European Union financial support, has long been trying to do something about them. Some were removed from the river by Communist Yugoslav authorities, but most have remained because of the explosives they carried.

Now, however, authorities are trying to keep traffic flowing on the Danube, which flows through 10 nations, as the dropping water levels create dangerous conditions. Experts have linked the unusually hot weather to global warming and other factors.

Earlier this month, Romania's army blasted a rock in a branch of the Danube River in an effort to increase the flow of cooling water to the Cernavoda nuclear power plant, where critically low water levels raised the risk of a shutdown.

The Cernavoda plant, which draws all of its cooling water from the Danube, has been threatened by the river's sharply reduced water levels caused by drought.

Also earlier in August, mortal remains of two German Wehrmacht soldiers were exposed by the historically low water level of the Danube near Budapest. A recovery specialist from the German War Graves Commission retrieved the remains from the riverbed in the Hungarian capital.

The team also found two identification tags at the site. According to the association, the bodies were found alongside a German military motorcycle and several anti-tank mines. Consequently, bomb disposal experts were deployed.

title.en: Trump's envoy Kushner meets with Hamas leader in push to revive Gaza peace plan
title.zh: 特朗普特使库什纳会见哈马斯领导人，推动加沙和平计划复兴

summary.en: Donald Trump's envoy, Jared Kushner, met with a Hamas leader to advance a peace plan for Gaza. The proposal includes Hamas disarming and Israeli troops withdrawing from the territory.
summary.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普的特使库什纳会见了哈马斯领导人，以推动加沙和平计划的复兴。该计划设想哈马斯解除武装，同时以色列军队撤出加沙。

body.en:
United States President Donald Trump's son-in-law and envoy Jared Kushner met Hamas' new leader in Egypt overnight in a push to revive a Gaza peace plan rejected by Israel.

Two weeks after Hamas endorsed the latest stage of Trump's Gaza plan by saying it would hand over weapons to a new governing committee, Kushner pressed for verifiable disarmament, a key demand of Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu.

Netanyahu rejected the Gaza peace plan on 9 August, saying Trump's latest roadmap for peace was "unacceptable".

Hamas chief Khalil al-Hayya took part in the discussions in the Egyptian Mediterranean city of El-Alamein, making his first trip since assuming leadership of the group in July .

In talks with Kushner, Hamas again voiced its commitment to the plan, a source familiar with the talks told Agence France-Presse.

The group said afterwards that it had called on mediators and Trump's so-called Board of Peace to "compel" Israel to "approve the roadmap ... and begin establishing a timetable for its implementation".

A picture released by host Egypt did not include al-Hayya, but showed Kushner at a table alongside members of the Board of Peace, including former United Kingdom prime minister Tony Blair. Qatar and Türkiye, key mediators alongside Egypt, also joined.

For years, the US refused contact with Hamas, but the Trump administration has increasingly been comfortable with direct contact in hopes of ending the devastating conflict, negotiating the October ceasefire agreement.

On Monday, Kushner will see Netanyahu, a longtime hawk who faces a tough re-election fight in October.

The three regional mediator countries and five other countries — Jordan, Saudi Arabia, the United Arab Emirates, Pakistan and Indonesia — condemned Israel's rejection of the plan on Sunday.

In a joint statement, they said "Israel bears direct and full responsibility" for obstructing peace, adding that its refusal "directly threatens to derail extensive efforts" by Trump.

In response, Netanyahu's Likud Party charged that "the Arab countries want to bring down the prime minister" in the election.

The inclusion of the United Arab Emirates is significant as it normalised relations with Israel five years ago.

Netanyahu expressed opposition to the US plan even after he was assured by Nickolay Mladenov, the Board of Peace's high representative for Gaza, that Israel would not need to pull troops out of the war-battered territory until complete disarmament by Hamas.

The board had initially said Israel would start a phased withdrawal in tandem with Hamas' disarmament.

title.en: UAE, Saudi Arabia, others condemn Israel's rejection of Trump Gaza plan
title.zh: 阿联酋、沙特阿拉伯等国谴责以色列拒绝特朗普加沙计划

summary.en: Several nations, including the UAE and Saudi Arabia, have condemned Israel's rejection of a Gaza peace plan proposed by the Trump administration. This condemnation occurred while US envoy Jared Kushner and Gaza peace envoy Nickolay Mladenov were engaged in ceasefire and implementation talks with regional mediators and...
summary.zh: 包括阿联酋和沙特阿拉伯在内的几个国家谴责以色列拒绝了特朗普政府提出的加沙和平计划。这一谴责发生之际，美国特使贾里德·库什纳和加沙和平特使尼古拉·姆拉德诺夫正在埃及与地区调解员及哈马斯举行停火和执行会谈。

body.en:
The statement came as US envoy Jared Kushner and Gaza peace envoy Nickolay Mladenov held ceasefire and implementation talks with regional mediators and Hamas in Egypt.

The United Arab Emirates and seven other countries on Sunday condemned Israel's rejection of US President Donald Trump's plan to end the war in the  Gaza Strip .

It comes a week after Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu rejected the 15-point plan for Gaza, stating that no military pullout will happen until Hamas is "genuinely" disarmed.

Trump's Board of Peace said last month that it had reached a deal for the complete disarmament of Hamas and other armed groups in Gaza.

The foreign ministers of the UAE, Qatar, Jordan, Indonesia, Pakistan, Turkey, Saudi Arabia and Egypt issued their joint statement as Trump's envoy and son-in-law, Jared Kushner, and Nickolay Mladenov, Trump's Board of Peace envoy for Gaza, were in Egypt for Gaza ceasefire-related talks.

Trump announced last month that there had been a breakthrough on a 15-point road map aimed at ending the war in the Gaza Strip.

The plan drawn up by his Board of Peace calls for Israeli troops to withdraw as Hamas gives up its weapons. An international stabilization force would then work alongside a new Palestinian police force to secure Gaza.

"Rejecting the Road Map constitutes an explicit refusal to proceed with the implementation of the Comprehensive Plan, and directly threatens to derail the extensive efforts exerted by US President Trump to bring an end to the war in Gaza and establish the conditions for lasting peace," the foreign ministers said in their Sunday statement.

"Such rejection confirms that Israel now bears responsibility for obstructing the efforts to bring peace in Gaza and the rest of the Occupied Palestinian Territory," they added.

They called on the Board of Peace and the US "to take immediate and concrete measures within its mandate to uphold the integrity of the Comprehensive Plan and prevent any party from obstructing its implementation."

Kushner met Hamas chief, Khalil al-Hayya, on Sunday according to several news agencies citing unnamed sources. 

Kushner and Mladenov were in Egypt and met with mediators from Egypt, Qatar and Turkey to discuss implementation of the deal.

Hamas on July 30 avoided using the term "disarmament," but said it would hand over its weapons to a new Palestinian governing body that would govern Gaza under the supervision of the Board of Peace.

The group, which is designated as a terrorist organization by several countries and the EU, called on mediators and the Board of Peace to "compel" Israel to approve the road map for next steps.

body.zh: 该声明发表之际，美国特使贾里德·库什纳和加沙和平特使尼古拉·姆拉德诺夫在埃及与地区调解员和哈马斯举行停火和实施会谈。 阿拉伯联合酋长国和其他七个国家周日谴责以色列拒绝唐纳德·特朗普总统结束加沙地带战争的计划。 一周前，以色列总理本杰明·内塔尼亚胡拒绝了针对加沙的 15 点计划，并表示在哈马斯“真正”解除武装之前不会进行军事撤军。 特朗普的和平委员会上个月表示，已达成一项全面解除哈马斯和加沙其他武装组织武装的协议。 在特朗普特使兼女婿贾里德·库什纳和特朗普加沙和平委员会特使尼古拉·姆拉德诺夫在埃及参加加沙停火相关谈判时，阿联酋、卡塔尔、约旦、印度尼西亚、巴基斯坦、土耳其、沙特阿拉伯和埃及外交部长发表了联合声明。 特朗普上个月宣布，旨在结束加沙地带战争的15点路线图取得了突破。 他的和平委员会制定的计划要求以色列军队在哈马斯放弃武器后撤军。然后，一支国际稳定部队将与一支新的巴勒斯坦警察部队合作，以确保加沙的安全。 各国外长在周日的声明中表示：“拒绝路线图就等于明确拒绝继续实施全面计划，并直接威胁到美国总统特朗普为结束加沙战争并为持久和平创造条件所做的广泛努力。” 他们补充说：“这种拒绝证实以色列现在对阻碍加沙和巴勒斯坦被占领土其他地区实现和平的努力负有责任。” 他们呼吁和平委员会和美国“在其职权范围内立即采取具体措施，维护全面计划的完整性，并防止任何一方阻挠其实施”。 据几家新闻机构援引未透露姓名的消息来源称，库什纳周日会见了哈马斯领导人哈利勒·哈亚。 库什纳和姆拉德诺夫在埃及会见了埃及、卡塔尔和土耳其的调解人，讨论协议的实施。 哈马斯7月30日避免使用“裁军”一词，但表示将把武器移交给新的巴勒斯坦管理机构，该机构将在和平委员会的监督下管理加沙。 该组织被多个国家和欧盟认定为恐怖组织，呼吁调解人和和平委员会“迫使”以色列批准下一步的路线图。 内塔尼亚胡此前表示，尽管以色列反对，但仍在与华盛顿进行谈判。

title.en: Ukraine attacks Wildberries, Russia's biggest online market
title.zh: 乌克兰袭击俄罗斯最大在线市场Wildberries

summary.en: Ukraine has been consistently targeting the warehouses of Russia's largest online retailer, Wildberries, since mid-July. While Ukraine states these attacks aim to disrupt front-line military shipments, experts suggest they are significantly impacting Russia's economy.
summary.zh: 自7月中旬以来，乌克兰几乎每天都在袭击俄罗斯最大的在线零售商Wildberries的仓库。乌克兰表示，此举旨在扰乱前线物资运输，但专家认为这正在严重影响俄罗斯经济。

body.zh: 自7月中旬以来，乌克兰几乎每天都以俄罗斯最大在线零售商Wildberry的仓库为目标。乌克兰表示，前线运输受到干扰。但专家表示，这正在扰乱俄罗斯的经济。 周日早些时候，位于莫斯科以南约 40 公里（25 英里）的波多利斯克镇的俄罗斯最大在线市场 Wildberry 的一个仓库发生火灾。这场火灾是乌克兰无人机夜间大规模袭击造成的，其中大部分无人机被俄罗斯防空系统拦截。 周五，乌克兰袭击了莫斯科北部特维尔的另一个 Wildberry 仓库。前一天，它还纵火焚烧了更东部萨拉瓦特的另一个仓库。 过去几周，大约 20 个 Wildberry 物流中心几乎每天都受到攻击。已确认至少九名员工死亡，数十人受伤，少数仓库已停止运营。 总部位于莫斯科的电子商务咨询公司 Data Insight 估计，Wildberry 已经损失了价值 4800 亿卢布（57 亿美元/49 亿欧元）的商品以及约三分之一的仓库空间。该公司及其卖家的损失估计高达 8000 亿卢布（95 亿美元）。 虽然基辅认为该零售商帮助供应俄罗斯军队，但莫斯科坚称其仅用于民用目的。不管怎样，袭击事件给俄罗斯经济带来了越来越大的压力。 地缘政治咨询公司 Rasmussen Global 首席执行官法布里斯·波蒂尔 (Fabrice Pothier) 告诉德国之声：“我认为（乌克兰）正在寻找一个瓶颈。” “从某种程度上来说，野莓是俄罗斯社会和俄罗斯经济的一个瓶颈。” 2022年俄罗斯全面入侵乌克兰并随后对俄罗斯贸易实施制裁后，亚马逊等许多在线电商平台退出了该地区。作为回应，俄罗斯当局允许所谓的平行进口，实质上是允许俄罗斯公司在未经原始权利人同意的情况下进口商品来规避制裁。 这些公司大幅降低传统价格，使其销量猛增。以 Wildberry 为例，其收入在 2021 年至 2025 年间增长了 7 倍。其竞争对手 Ozon 也提供了类似的惊人数字，据报道收入为 4,930 万美元，2025 年将增长 59%。 如今，Wildberry 已成为该国最大的电子商务平台，控制着该国约一半的市场。 Ozon 占据约 30% 的市场份额。它们处理的商品和服务合计相当于俄罗斯国内生产总值 (GDP) 的 8.5% 左右。 继 7 月中旬的最初袭击之后，乌克兰总统弗拉基米尔·泽连斯基 (Volodymyr Zelenskyy) 辩称，这些仓库......

reflection.en: In times of sustained conflict, when daily life and economic stability are repeatedly disrupted, it can be challenging to find a sense of constancy. Lamentations 3:22-23 reminds us that Yahweh’s mercies are new every morning, offering a steadfast hope even amidst ongoing trials and uncertainty.
reflection.zh: 在持续的冲突时期，当日常生活和经济稳定反复受到扰乱时，人们很难找到一种稳定感。《耶利米哀歌》3:22-23提醒我们，雅伟的慈爱每早晨都是新的，即使在持续的考验和不确定性中，也提供了坚定的盼望。

verse.textEn: Because of Yahweh's great love we are not consumed, for his compassions never fail. They are new every morning.
verse.textZh: 我们不至消灭，是出于雅伟诸般的慈爱；是因他的怜悯不至断绝。每早晨这都是新的。

title.en: Bus crash in Hungary kills at least 12
title.zh: 匈牙利巴士坠毁，至少12人死亡

summary.en: Police have arrested the driver of a bus that crashed in Hungary, killing at least 12 people. Reports indicated the bus was carrying Polish pilgrims.
summary.zh: 警方表示，一辆在匈牙利坠毁的巴士司机已被逮捕，事故造成至少12人死亡。据报道，该巴士载有波兰朝圣者。

body.en:
Police say they have arrested the driver of a bus that crashed in Hungary, killing at least 12 people. The bus was carrying Polish pilgrims, media report.

At least 12 people have died after a Polish coach crashed into a ditch and overturned in eastern Hungary , police said on Sunday.

According to emergency services, 47 people were injured in the incident, 10 seriously.

The accident occurred on the M3 motorway near Mezokeresztes, around 140 kilometers (87 miles) east of Budapest, according to police in the district capital, Miskolc. 

Police said they believe the driver fell asleep at the wheel during the overnight journey into Sunday. He was subsequently arrested.

Poland's PAP news agency reported that the bus had been carrying a group of pilgrims from Podkarpackie province in the far southeast of Poland .

The group, said to number 59 people, including two drivers, had been returning from Bosnia-Herzegovina , PAP said. 

Hungary's National Directorate for Disaster Management said that several of the passengers had been trapped under the vehicle when it overturned.

  Hungarian Prime Minister Peter Magyar has voiced his condolences to the families of the crash victims in a Facebook message and thanked emergency and rescue services.

Polish President Karol Nawrocki said he was deeply shaken. "In the face of this unimaginable tragedy, which affects us all, my thoughts and prayers go out to the families and loved ones of the victims," the 43-year-old wrote on X.

body.zh: 匈牙利警方称，一辆巴士发生车祸，造成至少 12 人死亡，司机已被捕。报道称，这辆巴士载有波兰朝圣者。 匈牙利警方周日表示，一辆波兰客车在匈牙利东部坠入沟渠翻车，已造成至少 12 人死亡。 据紧急服务部门称，事件中另有47人受伤，其中10人伤势严重。 据该地区首府米什科尔茨警方称，事故发生在布达佩斯以东约 140 公里（87 英里）处的 Mezokeresztes 附近的 M3 高速公路上。 警方表示，他们相信司机在周日的通宵旅程中在方向盘上睡着了。他随后被捕。 波兰人民通讯社报道称，这辆巴士载着一群来自波兰东南部喀尔巴阡山省的朝圣者。 人民行动党称，这群人据说有 59 人，其中包括两名司机，是从波斯尼亚和黑塞哥维那返回的。 匈牙利国家灾害管理局表示，车辆翻倒时，数名乘客被困在车下。 匈牙利总理彼得·马扎尔在脸书消息中向坠机遇难者家属表示哀悼，并对紧急救援服务表示感谢。 波兰总统卡罗尔·纳罗基表示，他深感震惊。这位 43 岁的人在 X 上写道：“面对这场影响我们所有人的难以想象的悲剧，我向受害者的家人和亲人致以思念和祈祷。” 不要让算法隐藏新闻。如果您信赖我们团队的可信报道，请花点时间选择我们作为您在 Google 上的首选来源，以便您始终能够首先看到我们经过验证的新闻。

reflection.en: The sudden loss of life in this bus crash brings profound sorrow to many. In moments of such tragedy, we remember that even Yahweh, in Jesus, wept at the death of a friend, showing divine empathy for human grief. This simple act reminds us that it is right to mourn and that our tears are seen.
reflection.zh: 这起巴士车祸中生命的突然逝去给许多人带来了深切的悲痛。在这样的悲剧中，我们记得雅伟在耶稣里也曾为朋友的离世而哭泣，这表明了神对人类悲伤的同情。这个简单的举动提醒我们，哀悼是正当的，我们的眼泪是被看见的。

verse.textEn: Jesus wept.
verse.textZh: 耶稣哭了。

title.en: Movie that went viral for terrible animation becomes China box office hit
title.zh: 因糟糕的动画而走红的电影成为中国票房热门

summary.en: Niu Lai's confusing plot and laughable animation quality has won ironic fans on the internet.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自中国栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Niu Lai, a low-budget animation film about a cow in a dream sequence has seen a huge jump in ticket sales after going viral for its confusing plot and terrible graphics.

It grossed just 7,705 yuan ($1,140; £843) in the first 10 days after its release, but has now made more than 11.4 million yuan, according to movie tracking site Mao Yan. That means it is holding ground against Hollywood blockbusters like The Odyssey and Spider Man: Brand New Day.

"You may regret for 80 minutes if you watch it, but if you don't, you'll regret it for life," one popular social media post about the film said.

Other social media users have hailed the movie as the antidote to the AI slop that is taking over social media algorithms.

They are sharing clips praising Niu Lai's "hand-crafted" method - a reference to the poor animation quality - as "proof" that its creators did not use AI.

Another social media user called it "pure handmade" and the biggest "dark horse" of the summer movie season.

Others say they are rooting for the movie because they desperately hope for a "bullish" stock market.

"If the index reaches 4,000 tomorrow I will go to the cinema to support this movie," one Weibo user wrote.

"It is a terrible movie but has a great name," another comment linking the movie to stock investments said.

Niu Lai was a low-budget, lowkey production from the outset, and had received almost no publicity before its release earlier this month.

But now it has proved so popular that cinemas have added screenings of the film in response to the soaring demand.

But given that it does not even have a proper promotional poster, cinema staff have resorted to drawing their own posters to entice audiences to watch.

"This record is unprecedented and will likely remain so," a Weibo account dedicated to tracking movies noted.

But not everyone is celebrating its unexpected success. Over the weekend, a commentary by state-owned Beijing News warned that cinemas risk "losing the trust" of viewers if they "continue to lower their standard" with additional screenings of Niu Lai.

Mentioning previous movies that had been mocked for poor quality, Niu Lai has "once again lowered the bar for audiences' expectations of poorly made films", reads a commentary by state-owned Beijing News.

It urged cinemas to "act as gatekeepers for the audience, and clearly reject films that are obviously not up to standard instead of letting films like Niu Lai run rampant".
body.zh: 《牛来》是一部讲述一头牛在梦境中的低成本动画电影，因其令人困惑的情节和糟糕的画面而走红后，票房收入大幅增长。 据电影追踪网站猫眼称，该片上映后 10 天的票房收入仅为 7,705 元人民币（1,140 美元；843 英镑），但目前已超过 1140 万元人民币。这意味着它在与《奥德赛》和《蜘蛛侠：全新一天》等好莱坞大片的竞争中占据一席之地。 “如果你看它，你可能会后悔80分钟，但如果你不看，你会后悔一生，”一篇关于这部电影的热门社交媒体帖子说道。 其他社交媒体用户称赞这部电影是应对正在接管社交媒体算法的人工智能问题的解毒剂。 他们分享的视频赞扬了牛来的“手工制作”方法——指的是糟糕的动画质量——作为其创作者没有使用人工智能的“证据”。 另一位社交媒体用户称其为“纯手工制作”，是暑期电影季最大的“黑马”。 其他人则表示，他们之所以支持这部电影，是因为他们迫切希望股市“牛市”。 一位微博用户写道：“如果明天指数达到4000，我会去电影院支持这部电影。” 另一位将这部电影与股票投资联系起来的评论说：“这是一部糟糕的电影，但名字却很好。” 《牛来》从一开始就是一部低预算、低调的作品，在本月初上映之前几乎没有受到任何宣传。 但现在事实证明，它非常受欢迎，以至于电影院增加了这部电影的放映次数，以应对不断飙升的需求。 但由于连合适的宣传海报都没有，影院工作人员只好自己画海报来吸引观众观看。 “这个记录是史无前例的，而且很可能会保持下去，”一个专门追踪电影的微博账号指出。 但并非所有人都在庆祝其意外的成功。周末，国有媒体《新京报》的一篇评论警告称，如果电影院“继续降低标准”增加放映《牛来》，就有“失去观众信任”的风险。 国有媒体《新京报》发表评论称，提到之前因质量低劣而被嘲笑的电影，牛来“再次降低了观众对劣质电影的期望”。 它敦促电影院“充当观众的把关人，明确拒绝那些明显不合格的电影，而不是让《牛来》这样的电影泛滥成灾”。

reflection.en: This story draws attention to peace-making and restraint. Matthew 5:9 reminds us to meet sharp headlines with mercy, truth, and restraint, asking how faithful people can respond with wisdom instead of noise.
reflection.zh: 这则新闻让人想到和平与克制。Matthew 5:9提醒我们，在快速变化的新闻里，仍要以怜悯、真实与节制来回应，并学习用祷告与分辨代替情绪化判断。

verse.textEn: Blessed are the peacemakers, for they will be called children of God.
verse.textZh: 使人和睦的人有福了，因为他们必称为神的儿子。

title.en: After Hormuz, China looks to the promise – and peril – of the Arctic’s ‘ice silk road’
title.zh: 继霍尔木兹海峡之后，中国着眼于北极“冰上丝绸之路”的机遇与风险

summary.en: China has initiated the first regular shipping transits through the Arctic's northern sea route, aiming to establish an "ice silk road." This new maritime path, however, raises significant concerns regarding its potential environmental impact and geopolitical implications.
summary.zh: 中国已开通北极航线的首次定期运输，旨在建立一条“冰上丝绸之路”。然而，这条新的海上航线在环境影响和地缘政治方面引发了重大担忧。

body.en: China has established the first scheduled transit through the northern sea route, but questions remain over the environmental and political risks When Marco Rubio suggested that the world should look to new shipping lanes to bypass the logjammed strait of Hormuz, it’s unlikely he had the Arctic’s northern sea route in mind. And yet in recent months the promise of this 5,500km channel – cleaved through frozen seas by nuclear-powered icebreakers and illuminated by a sun that never dips below the Arctic horizon – has grown. Continue reading...
body.zh: 中国已经建立了第一条通过北方海路的定期过境航线，但环境和政治风险仍然存在问题。当马可·卢比奥建议世界应该寻求新的航道以绕过堵塞的霍尔木兹海峡时，他不太可能想到北极的北方海路。然而近几个月来，这条 5,500 公里长的航道 — — 由核动力破冰船劈开冰冻的海洋，并由永远不会低于北极地平线的太阳照亮 — — 的前景越来越大。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The pursuit of new trade routes like the Arctic's "ice silk road" highlights humanity's drive for progress and efficiency. Yet, as the story notes, such ventures also carry significant environmental and political risks that demand careful consideration. Yahweh's wisdom encourages us to foresee danger and take precautions, rather than rushing headlong into...
reflection.zh: 像北极“冰上丝绸之路”这样的新贸易路线的开辟，彰显了人类对进步和效率的追求。然而，正如报道所指出的，此类项目也伴随着重大的环境和政治风险，需要我们审慎考量。雅伟的智慧鼓励我们预见危险并采取预防措施，而不是为了短期利益而贸然陷入潜在的危机。

verse.textEn: The prudent see danger and take refuge, but the simple keep going and pay the penalty.
verse.textZh: 通达人见祸藏躲；愚蒙人前往受害。

title.en: A fake website and a deluge of CVs: the Australian firm embroiled in an FBI probe into alleged Chinese espionage
title.zh: 虚假网站与大量简历：澳大利亚公司卷入联邦调查局对涉嫌中国间谍活动的调查

summary.en: An Australian firm has been caught up in an FBI investigation into alleged Chinese espionage, involving a fake consultancy website that impersonated the Brisbane company. This fake site was among 13 websites seized by the US Department of Justice.
summary.zh: 一家澳大利亚公司卷入联邦调查局对涉嫌中国间谍活动的调查，其中涉及一个冒充这家布里斯班公司的虚假咨询网站。这个虚假网站是美国司法部查获的13个网站之一。

body.en: Exclusive: Fake consultancy impersonating Brisbane firm online is one of 13 websites seized by the US Department of Justice Follow our Australia news live blog for latest updates Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast When the first emails arrived, they were easily dismissed as spam. But as strangers continued to boast about their defence and security credentials, they became impossible to ignore. From mid-2025, a small Australian consultancy firm called Horizzen started receiving emails and strange calls from people applying for vague jobs in the United States. Continue reading...
body.zh: 独家：在线冒充布里斯班公司的虚假咨询公司是美国司法部查获的 13 个网站之一 关注我们的澳大利亚新闻直播博客以获取最新更新 获取我们的突发新闻电子邮件、免费应用程序或每日新闻播客 当第一批电子邮件到达时，它们很容易被视为垃圾邮件而被忽略。但随着陌生人继续吹嘘他们的国防和安全资历，他们变得不可能被忽视。从 2025 年中期开始，一家名为 Horizzen 的澳大利亚小型咨询公司开始收到人们在美国申请模糊工作的电子邮件和奇怪的电话。继续阅读...

reflection.en: This news highlights how deception, even when elaborately crafted, often has a limited lifespan. While falsehoods may initially mislead, their true nature is eventually revealed, as seen in the seizure of these fake websites. Yahweh's word reminds us that truth ultimately prevails, and deceit cannot endure indefinitely.
reflection.zh: 这则新闻揭示了欺骗，即使精心策划，也往往寿命有限。虚假信息可能一时蒙蔽，但其真实面目终将被揭露，正如这些虚假网站被查获一样。雅伟的话语提醒我们，真理最终会得胜，谎言无法永远持续。

verse.textEn: Truthful lips endure forever, but a lying tongue lasts only a moment.
verse.textZh: 口吐真言，永远坚立；舌说谎话，只存片时。

title.en: How to buy a ‘mega-dinghy’: the perilous new model of Channel crossing
title.zh: 如何购买“巨型橡皮艇”：危险的英吉利海峡偷渡新模式

summary.en: The Guardian China reports on the alarming trend of large dinghies, capable of carrying hundreds, being used for perilous Channel crossings. The article investigates the supply chain for these vessels, noting that large orders are readily fulfilled by manufacturers.
summary.zh: 《卫报》中国版报道称，载有数百人的大型充气艇被用于危险的英吉利海峡偷渡，这一趋势令人担忧。文章调查了这些大型船只的来源，指出制造商可以轻松满足大批量订单。

body.en: Boats carrying hundreds of people are a clear and alarming trend. But where do such large vessels come from? Providing a large dinghy for use in the choppy seas of western Europe was not a problem, as long as the order was for more than 20 vessels, they said. The sales manager at the Chinese company even had an online brochure for an undercover Guardian reporter, posing as a prospective client, to peruse. They had a production capacity of 500 boats a month and, yes, it was possible to get even bigger ones for the right price. They could do a seven or even an eight-metre military-style dinghy for $1,678 (£1,238) a boat, without the engines, but that would be lacking CE certification, the mandatory mark that shows a product meets EU health and safety requirements. Additional reporting by Lyndon Li Continue reading...
body.zh: 载有数百人的船只是一个明显且令人震惊的趋势。但这么大的船只从哪里来呢？他们表示，只要订单超过 20 艘，提供一艘在西欧波涛汹涌的海域使用的大型小艇就不成问题。这家中国公司的销售经理甚至还为一位冒充潜在客户的卫报卧底记者准备了一份在线手册供其细读。他们的生产能力为每月 500 艘船，是的，有可能以合适的价格获得更大的船。他们可以以每艘 1,678 美元（1,238 英镑）的价格制造一艘七米甚至八米长的军用小艇，不带发动机，但这将缺乏 CE 认证，这是表明产品符合欧盟健康和安全要求的强制性标志。林登·李的补充报道继续阅读...

reflection.en: This report on the supply of vessels for perilous journeys reminds us of the vulnerable individuals seeking safety and new beginnings. Yahweh calls us to recognize His presence in those who are marginalized and in desperate need. Our compassion for 'the least of these' reflects our love for Him.
reflection.zh: 这篇关于用于危险旅程的船只供应的报道，提醒我们那些寻求安全和新生活的弱势个体。雅伟呼召我们要在那些被边缘化和极度需要的人身上认出祂的存在。我们对“这些最小的弟兄”的怜悯，反映了我们对祂的爱。

verse.textEn: Truly I tell you, whatever you did for one of the least of these brothers and sisters of mine, you did for me.
verse.textZh: 我实在告诉你们，这些事你们既做在我这弟兄中一个最小的身上，就是做在我身上了。

title.en: The Fauci hearing was painful to watch. But we need answers on Covid-19’s origin| David Relman
title.zh: 福奇听证会令人痛苦，但我们需要新冠病毒起源的答案 | 大卫·雷尔曼

summary.en: Despite recent congressional hearings, understanding the origin of Covid-19 remains elusive, with a microbiologist observing a deterioration in public discourse surrounding the issue.
summary.zh: 尽管近期国会举行了听证会，但了解新冠病毒的起源仍然困难重重，一位微生物学家指出，围绕这一问题的公共讨论正在恶化。

body.en: Despite the recent hearings in Congress, we seem to be even further from the goal of understanding Covid-19’s origin’s than we have ever been As a microbiologist and infectious disease clinician, it has been tough to watch the recent devolution of public discourse on Covid-19 origins. It has been especially difficult for me to read the comments of Anthony Fauci about the origins debate in his now-public diary . And it has been painful to watch the televised spectacle hosted by the US senator Rand Paul on 29 July involving a hostile interrogation of Fauci. Despite many early pleas, including my own , for a dispassionate, objective assessment of what we know, don’t know and need to know about Covid-19 origins, we seem to be even further from this goal now than we have ever been – plagued by politicization, polarization and illogical thinking. David Relman is a professor of medicine and microbiology at Stanford University. He was an inaugural member of the US National Science Advisory Board for Biosecurity and president of the Infectious Diseases Society of America Continue reading...
body.zh: 尽管最近在国会举行了听证会，但我们似乎距离了解 Covid-19 起源的目标比以往任何时候都更远。作为一名微生物学家和传染病临床医生，很难看到最近公众关于 Covid-19 起源的讨论的转移。对我来说，阅读安东尼·福奇在他现已公开的日记中关于起源争论的评论尤其困难。 7 月 29 日美国参议员兰德·保罗主持的电视节目对福奇进行敌意审讯，令人感到痛苦。尽管包括我自己在内的许多人早期呼吁对我们所知道、不知道和需要了解的 Covid-19 起源进行冷静、客观的评估，但我们现在似乎比以往任何时候都离这个目标更远——受到政治化、两极分化和不合逻辑思维的困扰。大卫·雷尔曼是斯坦福大学医学和微生物学教授。他是美国国家生物安全科学咨询委员会的首任成员和美国传染病学会主席继续阅读...

reflection.en: The struggle to understand complex issues like the origin of Covid-19, especially amidst contentious public discourse, reminds us of the wisdom in seeking thorough examination. Proverbs 18:17 suggests that true understanding emerges only after hearing all sides and carefully scrutinizing every claim. This calls for patience and a commitment to truth beyond...
reflection.zh: 在围绕新冠病毒起源等复杂问题展开的激烈公共讨论中，我们努力寻求理解，这提醒我们彻底审查的重要性。箴言18:17指出，真正的理解只有在听取各方意见并仔细审查每项主张之后才能浮现。这要求我们超越初步印象，以耐心和对真理的承诺，从而走向更清晰的道路。

verse.textEn: In a lawsuit the first to speak seems right, until someone comes forward and cross-examines.
verse.textZh: 先诉情由的，似乎有理；但邻舍来到，就察出实情。

title.en: ‘TikTok wouldn’t open at all’: Taiwan simulates an internet blackout, with an eye on China threat
title.zh: “抖音完全打不开”：台湾模拟互联网中断，以应对中国威胁

summary.en: Taiwan conducted its first internet blackout simulation, prompted by concerns over the security of its undersea cables, which are vital for its digital connectivity. During the exercise in Taipei, air raid sirens sounded, mobile alerts pinged, and police directed people off the streets.
summary.zh: 台湾周四首次进行互联网中断模拟演习，原因是担心作为其“数字生命线”的海底电缆的安全。在台北的演习中，防空警报响起，手机警报提示音不断，警察引导人们离开街道。

body.en: Taiwan practised cutting off internet for the first time amid concerns about the safety of the undersea cables that form its ‘digital lifeline’ In Taipei, the streets swiftly empty as air raid sirens ring out and alerts ping on mobile phones. Police officers usher any stragglers into shelters, leaving the capital suddenly deserted. In cities across Taiwan, these kinds of drills are a fact of life every year , amid the growing threat posed by China across the strait, but this time there is something different. Continue reading...

reflection.en: Taiwan's simulation of an internet blackout highlights the deep anxieties nations face regarding critical infrastructure and potential threats. In moments of such vulnerability and preparation, the ancient promise of Yahweh reminds us not to fear or be dismayed, for divine presence offers strength and help. This spiritual anchor can guide communities as...
reflection.zh: 台湾模拟互联网中断，凸显了各国在关键基础设施和潜在威胁面前的深层焦虑。在面对这种脆弱和准备的时刻，雅伟的古老应许提醒我们不要惧怕，也不要惊惶，因为神圣的同在提供力量和帮助。这个属灵的锚点可以指引社群应对复杂的挑战并建立韧性。

verse.textEn: So do not fear, for I am with you; do not be dismayed, for I am your God.
verse.textZh: 你不要害怕，因为我与你同在；不要惊惶，因为我是你的神。

title.en: The west turns a blind eye to Xi Jinping’s repressive regime in China | Letters
title.zh: 西方国家对习近平在中国的压制性政权视而不见 | 来信

summary.en: Jennifer Hubbard and other letter writers express concern that Western nations are ignoring China's repressive regime, particularly its 'ethnic unity' law used to suppress minorities. They argue that meaningful international diplomacy is urgently needed to address these human rights issues.
summary.zh: 詹妮弗·哈伯德及其他来信者表示，西方国家对中国压制性政权，特别是其用于压制少数民族的“民族团结”法视而不见。他们认为，急需有意义的国际外交来解决这些人权问题。

body.en: Meaningful diplomacy on an international level is well overdue, writes Jennifer Hubbard . Plus letters from Geoffrey Dixon and Jane Renton In his article on China’s latest tool for suppression of minorities, the “ethnic unity” law, Simon Tisdall seems to take it as read that western governments will continue to pay lip service to notions of human rights in China while pursuing short-term economic goals, ultimately destructive to their own productivity ( President Xi never wastes a good crisis. As Iran, Ukraine and Palestine distract the world, he tightens his grip, 8 August ). This has been the pattern since June 1989, the Tiananmen Square massacre. His faint hope that the young urban Chinese might overturn Xi’s regime is a judgment on the failure of western governments to show any foresight, integrity, effective diplomacy, joined-up thinking or action. They rely on the self-sacrifice of individuals such as Jimmy Lai , Lobga Rangzen and countless – often to us nameless – individuals who put their lives on the line while we wring our hands and weep crocodile tears. Continue reading...
body.zh: 詹妮弗·哈伯德写道，早就应该在国际层面开展有意义的外交。再加上杰弗里·迪克森和简·伦顿的来信。西蒙·蒂斯达尔在其关于中国镇压少数民族的最新工具“民族团结”法的文章中似乎认为，西方政府将继续对中国的人权观念口头上说好，同时追求短期经济目标，最终损害他们自己的生产力（习主席从来不会浪费一场好的危机。随着伊朗、乌克兰和巴勒斯坦分散了世界的注意力，他加强了控制，8月8日）。这就是1989年6月天安门广场屠杀以来的模式。他对中国城市年轻人可能推翻习近平政权的微弱希望是对西方政府未能表现出任何远见、正直、有效外交、联合思维或行动的判断。他们依赖于黎智英（Jimmy Lai）、洛布加·让赞（Lobga Rangzen）等个人的自我牺牲，以及无数（通常对我们来说无名）个人的自我牺牲，他们冒着生命危险，而我们则绞尽脑汁，流下鳄鱼的眼泪。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The call for international diplomacy to address the suppression of minorities echoes the biblical mandate to speak for those who cannot speak for themselves. In a world where powerful voices can overshadow the vulnerable, Yahweh reminds us of our responsibility to advocate for justice and the rights of the destitute. May we seek wisdom and courage to uphold...
reflection.zh: 呼吁国际外交以解决少数民族受压迫的问题，与圣经中为不能为自己说话之人发声的命令不谋而合。在一个强大声音可能掩盖弱势群体的世界里，雅伟提醒我们有责任倡导正义和维护贫困者的权利。愿我们寻求智慧和勇气，维护所有人的尊严，特别是那些声音被压制的人。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.

title.en: Taiwan says it was hit by ‘abnormal’ AI-assisted cyber-attack
title.zh: 台湾称遭受“异常”人工智能辅助网络攻击

summary.en: Taiwan reported detecting "abnormal" AI-assisted cyber-attacks on government agencies last month, originating from overseas. These attacks represent a new kind of threat, with suspected links to China-based hackers.
summary.zh: 台湾报告称，上个月侦测到来自海外、由人工智能辅助的“异常”网络攻击，目标是政府机构。这些攻击代表了一种新型威胁，据称与中国相关黑客有关。

body.en: Taiwan’s statement comes a day after reports that suspected China-linked hackers had carried out a first-of-a-kind breach Taiwan says it detected AI-assisted cyber-attacks on government agencies that came from overseas last month, a new kind of threat that has been reported as “first-of-a-kind breach”. The Ministry of Digital Affairs (MDA) said its cybersecurity monitoring units ‌detected the “abnormal attack” targeting government agencies, which began on 20 July. The National Institute of Cyber Security issued a series of warning alerts while it investigated. Continue reading...
body.zh: 台湾发表声明的前一天，有报道称疑似与中国有关的黑客实施了史无前例的违规行为。台湾表示，上个月检测到来自海外的针对政府机构的人工智能辅助网络攻击，这是一种新的威胁，被报道为“史无前例的违规行为”。数字事务部 (MDA) 表示，其网络安全监控单位检测到 7 月 20 日开始的针对政府机构的“异常攻击”。美国国家网络安全研究所在调查过程中发布了一系列警告。继续阅读...

Proverbs 27:12 reminds us that wisdom lies in foreseeing danger and taking appropriate refuge. As technology evolves, so must our discernment and protective measures, trusting Yahweh for guidance.
reflection.zh: 人工智能辅助的网络攻击的出现，凸显了在快速变化的世界中保持警惕的持续必要性。箴言27:12提醒我们，智慧在于预见危险并采取适当的避难措施。随着科技发展，我们的洞察力和保护措施也必须随之进步，信靠雅伟的指引。

In 1991, Zhu was summoned to Beijing, in the footsteps of the then president and party secretary Jiang Zemin , and in the aftermath of the 1989 uprisings in Beijing and the collapse of the Soviet Union. title.en: Government unveils last-minute gambling reforms ahead of critical new report

summary.zh: 这是一则来自澳洲栏目的新闻，重点涉及领导、智慧与公共责任。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Sweeping last-minute changes to Labor's gambling reforms, including a crackdown on inducements, have been unveiled in parliament, hours before the release of a damning report on the matter.

A Senate committee report on the proposed changes was tabled on Monday night, slamming the government's attempt to protect vulnerable people from gambling addictions as being too little, too late.

It contained criticism from the coalition, Greens and independent senator David Pocock.

The reforms were referred to the committee for an inquiry over concerns they did not adequately break the connection between betting and sport nor protect kids from gambling exposure.

"This package is not an evidence-led public health response to a public health issue," Pocock said in the report.

"It leaves gambling advertising embedded in sport and across Australian media, shifts responsibility onto parents and preserves major parts of the system that have made Australians the biggest gambling losers in the world on a per capita basis."

The changes respond to concerns from the Greens, who said they would not support the bill in its earlier form.

"Inducements are a toxic practice that prey on those who can least afford to gamble and must be outlawed," Greens senator Sarah Hanson-Young said.

"Gambling companies must not be allowed to continue to make massive profits off vulnerable people."

The government also pledged a new opt-out register for gambling ads, which would allow Australians to sign up for a one-stop shop for removing the ads from online platforms.

It would function similarly to the Do Not Call register for spam calls, following concerns raised that people would struggle to stay on top of individual opt-out options on each online service.

A levy would be imposed on gambling companies to cover the cost of the register, Communications Minister Anika Wells told parliament.

But critics of the government's work, including the coalition, have said the drawn-out changes were far too delayed.

A report by late Labor MP Peta Murphy into the matter was published in 2023 and contained more than 30 recommendations to limit the power of Australia's gambling industry.

Feedback in the committee report noted many of the recommendations had not been included in the reforms.

"Even the government's response to this (Murphy's) report, tabled on May 12, 2026 — the day of the federal budget when many journalists were in the budget lock-up — became a cynical exercise in media management," the coalition said in its response.

The amendments are expected to be debated on Tuesday and signify an end to lengthy pushback from the coalition...

body.en:
Political battle lines are being drawn over superannuation, with Labor vowing to defend the retirement savings system as the Liberal Party and One Nation attack it as a failure.

On Monday, Treasurer Jim Chalmers signalled super could become a political issue at the next federal election.

"The stakes are high at the next election for a whole range of reasons, and one of them now is the future of Australia's world-leading compulsory superannuation system," Chalmers told reporters as he arrived at Parliament House.

"The Liberals, the Nationals, and One Nation would end compulsory superannuation as we know it. Their policy and their ideology on super would absolutely decimate the economic security and retirement incomes of millions of Australian workers.

"They share a dangerous and divisive anti-worker, anti-super ideology, and if this plays out after the next election, Australian workers will be much worse off."

However a senior Liberal senator later sought to dispute that was the party's ambition.

The stoush began last week when Liberal senator Andrew Bragg declared superannuation an "illiberal experiment".

"It’s one of the biggest public policy failures since federation, in the sense that it hasn’t helped the budget, and it has not really helped many people get off the pension," he told ABC radio on Thursday.

"What it has done is it has created a huge viper's nest for banks and financiers and unions to pilfer, which is why what you saw at the Labor Party conference was now you're going to have super for under 18s."

The Association of Superannuation Funds Australia (ASFA) refuted Bragg's comments, pointing out Australia's age pension expenditure had decreased since the scheme was introduced in 1992.

"Super has meant that even as our population ages, the government's Age Pension bill is going down instead of up. OECD projections have Australia at the lowest public pension spending in the OECD by the mid-2030s," ASFA CEO Mary Delahunty said.

"Super has also meant that reliance on the Age Pension has fallen, with 12 per cent fewer over-65s receiving a part or full Age Pension today than in 2012. This will keep falling as we see the effects of higher super guarantees coming in.

Under the current system, all Australian employers are required to pay a minimum 12 per cent of an employee's salary into a nominated super fund, which cannot be accessed until a person is 60.

Deputy Opposition leader Jane Hume said the Liberals would not make any changes to compulsory super, saying the treasurer was "simply making things up".

body.en:
Several Sydney Swans players are being investigated over an alleged sexual assault in Melbourne.

Victoria Police on Monday said they were investigating a report of sexual assault, as Sydney confirmed several Swans players were involved in an "alleged incident".

Police attended the Pullman Hotel in East Melbourne on Monday after an incident in the early hours of that morning.

The Swans stayed at the hotel on Sunday night after their 36-point win over Essendon at the MCG that locked in second place on the ladder and a home qualifying final.

On Monday afternoon, Swans chief executive Matthew Pavlich addressed the media in Sydney and again confirmed players had been involved in an "alleged incident", but didn't offer further details.

"We can confirm that several players were involved in an alleged incident last night in Melbourne," Pavlich said.

"We've identified this to the AFL that we are working with them and also the relevant authorities on this matter.

"We're still piecing together exactly what's transpired here and have our own set of internal inquiries ongoing.

"But safe to say that we're extremely shocked and disappointed that this has taken place and that the players have found themselves in this situation.

"We understand the level of interest in the matter, and there'd be lots of speculation, but given it's a police matter right now, that is all that we can say."

"As I said, it's a police matter ongoing. I'm not going to comment any further on it right now," Pavlich said.

Police had earlier confirmed they were investigating a report of sexual assault.

"Police are investigating a report of a sexual assault in East Melbourne on 17 August," Victoria Police said in a statement provided to the Australian Associated Press.

"The incident occurred at a hotel on Wellington Parade in the early hours of the morning.

"The exact circumstances are yet to be established, and the investigation into the incident remains ongoing."

South Australia has refused to join a planned national gun buyback, warning it will not spend state funds on a scheme it says should be paid for entirely by Canberra.

South Australian Treasurer Tom Koutsantonis says the state is not interested in signing up to a model that relies on state co‑funding rather than being fully funded by the Commonwealth.

South Australia cannot divert money from essential services and cost‑of‑living priorities into a program driven by federal politics, he said.

"We think we've got the balance right here in South Australia, but if the Commonwealth government want to embark on a buyback scheme under the same process that John Howard did, they're more than welcome to," Koutsantonis told ABC radio.

"The John Howard buyback was fully funded by the Commonwealth government, so they funded it in its entirety."

Koutsantonis said all states faced broader funding pressures to keep up with demand for health, disability and other frontline services.

On Sunday, Prime Minister Anthony Albanese and NSW Premier Chris Minns announced details of the state's buyback, which is due to begin in November.

NSW is currently the only jurisdiction participating in the national scheme, which was promised after last December's Bondi terror attack in which 15 people were killed.

Conservative governments in Queensland, Tasmania and the Northern Territory have also declined to sign up to the buyback.

Western Australia has already run its own gun buyback and has no plans for a second scheme linked to the Bondi attack.

In Victoria, former premier Jacinta Allan had previously baulked at joining the national buyback, denting Canberra's hopes of broad state participation.

Her resignation and replacement by Ben Carroll has created uncertainty ahead of the 28 November election as the new premier weighs how far to go on firearms.

The stand-off has revived comparisons with former Liberal prime minister Howard's 1996 post‑Port Arthur buyback, funded entirely by the Commonwealth through a temporary Medicare levy.

Gun‑rights advocates say Albanese's approach falls short of that standard and unfairly targets law‑abiding shooters while failing to address extremism and radicalisation.

Sporting shooters are among a broad range of pro‑gun groups attacking the post‑Bondi reforms at federal and state level, alongside the Coalition and One Nation.

In regional NSW, independent Barwon MP Roy Butler said the Minns government's approach unfairly targeted farmers and sporting shooters in his vast western electorate.

title.en: Why mushroom killer Erin Patterson is returning to court this week

summary.en: A 51-year-old woman, Erin Patterson, is returning to court this week while serving a life sentence. She was found guilty of fatally poisoning three relatives during a family lunch.

body.en:
Erin Patterson, dubbed 'the mushroom killer' after a sensational case, will return to court this week in a bid to overturn her murder convictions for deliberately poisoning three relatives.

Patterson, 51, was last year jailed for life with a non-parole period of 33 years after she was found guilty of murdering her estranged husband's parents, Don and Gail Patterson, both 70, and Gail's sister, Heather Wilkinson, 66.

She killed them by lacing beef Wellington with lethal death cap mushrooms at a family lunch at her Leongatha home in Gippsland, Victoria, in July 2023.

Patterson was also found guilty of attempting to murder Heather's husband Ian Wilkinson, who became gravely ill but survived.

Patterson argued the deaths were a tragic accident, claiming the poisonous fungi were unintentionally included in the meal, and she later covered up her actions in a panic.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

The case garnered unprecedented public and media attention and was the subject of several books, television shows and podcasts.

Patterson will face a two-day hearing that starts on Wednesday at Victoria's Court of Appeal in Melbourne's CBD.

The hearing is an application for leave to appeal, which is a formal request to the court to hear the appeal.

The prosecution and defence will submit written and oral arguments, before a full panel of three judges will determine whether the case has merit for an appeal.

If Patterson is successful, the court could quash her convictions and order a retrial, or acquit her.

If the court rules against her, her convictions will stand, and she will serve out the remainder of her sentence.

In that instance, she could appeal to the High Court, which is Australia's highest court and can overturn decisions made in lower courts.

The Director of Public Prosecutions is also appealing the length of the sentence, arguing Patterson — who will be 82 years old when she is eligible for parole in 2056 — should be locked up for life.

If they are successful, Patterson could be re-sentenced to life without parole or a non-parole period of greater than 33 years.

Patterson is not expected to attend the hearing in person, instead appearing via video link from prison.

In documents lodged with the court last year, Patterson, who has always maintained her innocence, argued she suffered a "miscarriage of justice" during the 10-week trial, laying out seven grounds of appeal.

She claimed the prosecution's five-day cross-examination of her was "unfair and oppressive", while the prosecution's closing address "caused a substantial miscarriage of justice".

body.en:
A coalition of rights groups is pleading with the federal government not to revoke work rights for asylum seekers, warning it could expose people to illegal employment conditions and cash-in-hand jobs.

Under pressure on migration policy, the Albanese government is reportedly considering removing work rights for temporary migrants applying for protection visas.

The move has not been formally announced, but the ABC reported the plan was due to be announced earlier this month in a since-cancelled speech by Home Affairs Minister Tony Burke, as part of a move to reduce migration numbers by cracking down on temporary visas and the number of overseas arrivals.

Sources told the ABC discussions within the federal cabinet centred on dealing with people who overstayed their visas, often on bridging visas.

The reports have alarmed community, charity, multicultural and migrant organisations, with over 160 writing to Prime Minister Anthony Albanese warning it would push people to poverty and exploitation, potentially resorting to cash-in-hand employment to make ends meet.

This would then make them "more vulnerable to wage theft, unsafe working conditions, exploitation and abuse. This is fundamentally at odds with Labor’s values," the joint letter, which includes prominent groups like Anglicare Australia, GetUp, Human Rights Law Centre and Multicultural Australia, reads.

The organisations warned that their charities would be forced to shoulder the burden of support at a time when they're already over-stretched.

They said most asylum seekers are unable to access Centrelink and revoking work rights would have "profound" consequences.

"For many people, the right to work is therefore the difference between being able to support themselves and being unable to pay for food, rent, and other essentials."

The organisations acknowledged lengthy wait times in processing asylum and protection claims in the system, but proposed a number of alternatives as a solution, including investing money in ensuring applications are properly assessed by Home Affairs initially, and review tribunals are properly resourced, so that asylum seekers have a "fair chance" to make their case.

"We recognise that Australia's protection system is facing serious backlogs. Those delays undermine confidence in the system and cause real harm and distress to people who can spend years living with uncertainty, waiting for a final decision. We all have an interest in a protection system that is fast, fair and effective."

title.en: 'Not where the problems are': Working holiday visa slowdown divides parties
title.zh: “问题不在那里”：打工度假签证放缓引发党派分歧

body.en:
The federal government has confirmed it will slow the processing of working holiday visa applications as pressure mounts to reduce net migration numbers. 

Nine newspapers first reported on Saturday that the federal government had paused applications for working holiday visas from 24 countries.

But Home Affairs Minister Tony Burke confirmed on Sunday that working holiday visas were still being processed, but they were being handled "more slowly than they were previously".

However, when asked about the impact of fewer backpackers on the agriculture sector, he pointed to a Pacific workers' scheme as the primary visa for temporary staff.

"One of the things that happened when we started to improve worker protections on (the Pacific scheme) was ... some of the worst operators said, "if we've got to have better standards for (those) workers, we'll just switch to backpackers".

Working holiday visas — often called "backpacker visas" — allow travellers to extend their stay in Australia by undertaking work that addresses labour shortages in Australia — often fruit picking, farm work, mining, or tourism work in regional and remote areas.

The number of working holiday visa holders in Australia passed 210,000 in June 2025, outpacing pre-COVID figures by around 100,000.

The move comes as pressure builds on the Albanese government to bring down net overseas migration, with other parties carving out their migration policy.

Migration experts have warned of the dangers of political parties attempting to blame migrants for a lack of homes , arguing that migrant workforces will be essential to building the required housing stock .

Net overseas migration — a measure covering visitors, family and partner visas, working holidaymakers, skilled migration, and humanitarian intake, alongside returning Australians — fell slightly to 301,000 in 2025, down from 306,000 the year before, according to the Australian Bureau of Statistics.

Labor's long-term target is 225,000 a year over the next three years, though Burke said on Sunday the party's migration policy was still being worked through and needed to go through a full cabinet process.

None of the major parties has yet specified which visa categories they'd cut to hit their targets — though the Coalition has said intake should be tied to housing completions rather than a fixed annual figure.

title.en: Government admits NDIS reforms will impact families, downplays fears over state readiness
title.zh: 政府承认国家残疾保险计划改革将影响家庭，淡化对各州准备情况的担忧

summary.en: The federal disability minister has defended proposed changes to the National Disability Insurance Scheme (NDIS), acknowledging that the reforms will affect families. The minister also indicated that further amendments are planned to combat fraud and secure parliamentary approval.
summary.zh: 联邦残疾事务部长为国家残疾保险计划（NDIS）的改革措施进行了辩护，承认这些改革将影响到家庭。部长还表示，将进一步修订以打击欺诈行为并争取议会支持。

body.en:
Labor has downplayed concerns that state-based disability supports won't be ready when needed, as the government pushes contentious NDIS reforms targeting fraud and spending through parliament.

A government-led Senate inquiry on Friday recommended National Disability Insurance Scheme changes should be passed with no substantial alterations.

The overhaul would cut a targeted $37.8 billion from the NDIS over four years and remove 160,000 participants by tightening eligibility requirements.

NDIS Minister Jenny McAllister said a deal between the government and the coalition to pass the changes was getting close.

"We're really hopeful and I'd go as far as saying confident that we can reach an agreement," she told ABC's Insiders program on Sunday.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Opposition health spokeswoman Anne Ruston called for a strengthened fraud and corruption response within the disability insurance agency in the inquiry report.

Senator McAllister said the government was still considering evidence brought forward during the inquiry process and flagged fraud as an area to work through with the coalition.

But concerns about the changes remain among advocates — and from at least one state.

In a joint statement, 12 disability advocacy organisations said the reforms should not pass parliament in their current form.

"It must guarantee that people are not diverted from, or lose, NDIS supports unless alternative supports are funded, operational, accessible and available in practice."

Queensland has resisted signing up to the Thriving Kids program, a major plank in federal plans to cut costs from the NDIS.

Under the program, which is due to be rolled out from October, some children aged eight and under with autism or developmental delays would be shifted onto state supports.

Queensland Disability Minister Amanda Camm has refused to back the agreement, labelling the change a cost-shifting exercise that lacked detail.

Despite the conflict, Labor remained confident people with a disability would not be left without the support they needed.

"We don't need to contemplate delay at this point, because we are working with the states and territories toward that January 1 deadline."

Labor's NDIS plan would lead to average funding being cut by about $5000 a year for participants.

"It is a reduction and we don't deny that it will have impacts on people with disability and their families," Senator McAllister said.

She again dismissed calls to introduce an NDIS inspector-general, saying it would risk adding another layer of bureaucracy.

body.zh: 随着政府通过议会推动有争议的针对欺诈和支出的 NDIS 改革，工党淡化了对州级残疾人支持无法在需要时准备就绪的担忧。 周五由政府主导的参议院调查建议，国家残疾保险计划的变更应在不进行实质性修改的情况下通过。 此次改革将在四年内从 NDIS 中削减 378 亿美元，并通过收紧资格要求减少 16 万名参与者。 NDIS 部长珍妮·麦卡利斯特 (Jenny McAllister) 表示，政府和联盟之间即将达成协议以通过这些变革。 “我们真的充满希望，我什至有信心我们能够达成协议，”她周日告诉美国广播公司的内部人士节目。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 反对党卫生发言人安妮·鲁斯顿在调查报告中呼吁残疾保险机构加强欺诈和腐败应对措施。 麦卡利斯特参议员表示，政府仍在考虑调查过程中提出的证据，并将欺诈行为列为与联盟合作解决的一个领域。 但至少一个州的倡导者仍然对这些变化感到担忧。 12 个残疾人权益倡导组织在一份联合声明中表示，改革措施不应以目前的形式在议会获得通过。 “它必须保证人们不会被转移或失去 NDIS 支持，除非替代支持有资金、可操作、可获取且在实践中可用。” 昆士兰州拒绝签署“Thriving Kids”计划，该计划是联邦政府削减 NDIS 成本的计划的一个主要内容。 该计划将于 10 月开始实施，一些 8 岁及以下患有自闭症或发育迟缓的儿童将获得国家支持。 昆士兰州残疾人事务部长阿曼达·卡姆（Amanda Camm）拒绝支持该协议，并将这一变化称为缺乏细节的成本转移活动。 尽管存在冲突，工党仍然相信残疾人不会失去所需的支持。 “目前我们不需要考虑推迟，因为我们正在与各州和领地合作，争取 1 月 1 日的最后期限。” 工党的 NDIS 计划将导致参与者的平均资助每年减少约 5000 美元。 参议员麦卡利斯特说：“这是一种减少，我们不否认它将对残疾人及其家人产生影响。” 她再次驳回了引入 NDIS 监察长的呼吁，称这可能会增加另一层官僚机构。 如需了解 SBS 新闻的最新动态，请下载我们的应用程序并订阅我们的时事通讯。

reflection.en: As governments consider reforms to vital support systems like the NDIS, the call for justice and righteousness remains paramount. Yahweh reminds leaders to protect the vulnerable, ensuring that policy changes do not inadvertently harm those who rely on these provisions. Our hope is that all reforms are guided by compassion and a commitment to the well-being...
reflection.zh: 当政府考虑改革国家残疾保险计划等重要支持系统时，对公义和正直的呼吁至关重要。雅伟提醒领导者要保护弱势群体，确保政策变化不会无意中伤害那些依赖这些保障的人。我们希望所有的改革都能以怜悯为指导，并致力于每个公民的福祉。

verse.textEn: Do what is just and right. Rescue from the hand of the oppressor the one who has been robbed.
verse.textZh: 你们要施行公平和公义，拯救被抢夺的脱离欺压人的手。
